research_result.description: LiveAgent is a customer support and helpdesk platform providing ticketing, live chat, call center, and knowledge base functionality.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can obtain credentials by registering for a 30-day free trial account (no credit card required). API v3 keys are generated in the agent panel under Configuration > System > API. Personal MCP Bearer tokens and OAuth 2.1 applications are managed under profile settings (Edit Profile > MCP Integration).

evidence.claim: LiveAgent provides a REST API for programmatic access to tickets, conversations, agents, and system settings.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: It is possible to use call LiveAgent API also without support of mod_rewrite in your Apache (or something similar).

evidence.claim: LiveAgent REST APIs are authenticated via API keys, while its MCP server supports Bearer tokens and OAuth 2.1.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Bearer token — generate an MCP access token in your profile and paste it into the client manually.

evidence.claim: LiveAgent includes a built-in MCP server that enables external AI tools to read ticket data and perform actions.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: LiveAgent exposes a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools — such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai, FlowHunt, or any other MCP-compatible client — directly to your LiveAgent account.

evidence.claim: LiveAgent provides a 30-day free trial without requiring a credit card.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Start with a 30-day free trial. No credit card required. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime.
